name: evaldiff
description: Evaluation-first regression testing for AI apps: JSONL datasets, graders, baseline diffs, and PR scorecards.

scripts.demo: node bin/evaldiff.js run --cases examples/cases.jsonl --adapter examples/app.mjs --baseline examples/baseline.json --out .evaldiff/current.json --report .evaldiff/comparison.json --markdown .evaldiff/report.md
